title: Extension of an assignment
statement: Let $P$ be a constraint instance with variable set $V$, domain $D$, and at least one element in $D$. Given an assignment from the participating variables of $P$ to $D$, extend it to all of $V$ by retaining those assigned values on participating variables and choosing one fixed element of $D$ for every nonparticipating variable.
hypotheses_covered: A raw CSP instance P with domain D and variable set V
An assignment from P's participating variables to D
